title: I was/did ... We were/did ...
text: Two weeks ago, Su Hai wanted to play Mulan in a school play.
She used her dancing skills to do them well.
Finally, it was time for the play.
There were a lot of words in the play.
Last week, Bobby and Sam saw a new poster at school.
First he forgot the words, but then he remembered them.

Long ago, there was a snail in a garden. It ______ (live) under a tall tree. One day, it ______ (see) a bird at the top of the tree. The snail ______ (want) to climb the tree and see the garden from the top of the tree. But it ______ (be) very slow. What could the snail do?
sentences: Two weeks ago, Su Hai wanted to play Mulan in a school play.
Finally, it was time for the play.
There were a lot of words in the play.
Last week, Bobby and Sam saw a new poster at school.
Long ago, there was a snail in a garden.
